settings.editor: Straightforward payment options, discreet packaging, and reliable tracked shipping to most destinations worldwide.

After placing your order you will receive a confirmation email (check your spam folder). Note the order amount and number, then complete your payment within 3 days. Unpaid orders may be cancelled after this period. Always include your order number in the transfer reference.
Wallet details are shared securely by email once your order is confirmed, for a fast, private, and fully traceable settlement.
Pay securely with Visa, Mastercard, or American Express directly at checkout, no manual transfer required.
